gameSystem.name: Lanterns of the Mire
gameSystem.description: An original mystery game of folk-beings and lantern light in the 1870s North, built on the Year Zero Engine SRD.

entries.text: Water-horse: a pale horse at the river's edge that begs to be ridden and never stops at the bank
Forest-wife: a woman of the deep woods, lovely from the front and hollow as a rotten stump behind
Drowned one: a sailor the sea did not keep, walking ashore to demand a proper grave
Night-rider: a weight that sits on sleepers' chests and drinks their breath
Marsh-light: a wandering flame that leads travellers off the causeway into the bog
Changeling: a child that is not the child, left in the cradle by the hill-folk
Barrow-dweller: the restless lord of an old mound, jealous of every stone of it
Church-grim: a black dog that guards the churchyard and hunts those who rob it
Hill-folk: proud people under the hill who keep old bargains to the letter
Mine-keeper: a woman of the deep seams who rewards respect and buries the greedy
Hearth-gnome: a small old one of the farmstead, generous until it is slighted
Sea-wife: a voice in the waves that calls fishermen to her and keeps them
Revenge for a wrong done long ago
A promise kept that someone's grandparent broke
Something stolen from it, given back
A child, owed to it by an old bargain
To be remembered with the old offerings
Its land back, now ploughed, dammed or mined
Release from a binding someone laid on it
A mortal's company, forever
A mill village on a fast river
A manor house with a shuttered wing
A lighthouse on a lonely skerry
A mining town high in the fells
A parish church and its old churchyard
A ferry crossing lost in fog
A university town and its crumbling library
A fishing hamlet at the edge of the ice
Footprints that end in the middle of a field
A smell of wet earth and river weed indoors
An old ballad the elders will not finish
A page missing from the parish register
A witness who dreamed it before it happened
An iron charm, nailed up and then torn down
Something missing that no thief would want
Animals that refuse to go near one place
A child's drawing of a visitor no one else saw
A name carved into an old beam, then scratched out
The light fails: lanterns gutter and go out
The locals turn on you: strangers bring trouble
A witness vanishes
The weather closes in: snow, fog or flood
A rival wants the credit, or the creature
The authorities forbid you to go further
Someone you trust lies to you
It is watching you now

trackers.name: Clues
trackers.hint: Rises when an inquiry finds something. At 4 you know enough to unmask the folk-being.

trackers.name: Nightfall
trackers.hint: Fills as time runs out. When it is full, the folk-being strikes.

tags.label: Suspect
tags.hint: May be behind it, or hiding it

sceneTypes.name: Inquiry
sceneTypes.purpose: Investigation: question witnesses, search places and records, piece the mystery together.

setup.title: Where do you look, and for what?
setup.prompt: Say where the scene is set and what you hope to learn. Give it a short title.

setup.title: Find a clue
setup.prompt: Roll for what you find, then say how it fits the mystery so far.

play.title: Dig deeper
play.prompt: Pick how you dig: Lore, Inquiry, Alertness, Persuade or Insight. A success adds a Clue; a failure lets the night draw in.

bands.label: Not enough yet: keep digging, or face what comes.
You know enough: when ready, end the Investigation and unmask the folk-being.

sceneTypes.name: Struggle
sceneTypes.purpose: Danger: chases, fights, storms and the folk-being's tricks, where you act to survive.

setup.title: What threatens you?
setup.prompt: Say what danger you face and where. Give the scene a short title.

setup.title: Add a complication
setup.prompt: Roll for a complication and work it into the danger.

play.title: Act to survive
play.prompt: Pick how you act: Brawl, Endure, Haul, Shoot, Sneak or Nimble. A failure lets the night draw in.

sceneTypes.name: Respite
sceneTypes.purpose: Rest: tend wounds, steady your nerves and remember why you came. Time passes.

setup.title: Where do you rest, and with whom?
setup.prompt: Say where you find shelter and who keeps you company. Give the scene a short title.

play.title: How do you recover?
play.prompt: Resting costs time: the night draws in.

sceneTypes.name: Confrontation
sceneTypes.purpose: The unmasking: name the folk-being, face it, and settle what it wants.

setup.title: Name the folk-being
setup.prompt: Roll to learn what has been behind it all, then say how your clues pointed to it.

setup.title: Learn what it wants
setup.prompt: Roll for its want, then say what that means for the people here.

setup.title: Stand fast
setup.prompt: It shows itself. Roll Stand Fast.

play.title: Settle it
play.prompt: Banish it with Lore, bargain with Persuade, or fight it with Brawl or Shoot. On a failure it marks you.

flows.name: A Mystery
flows.description: One mystery for one investigator: a letter calls you to a place where the hidden folk stir. Investigate, then unmask what is behind it.
flows.introduction: You are the whole table. Make your investigator, read the letter that calls you, then play scenes of Inquiry, Struggle and Respite until you know enough. Clues bring you closer; Nightfall runs out the time. Roll with a pool of six-sided dice: every six is a success. Any roll with a missed die can be pushed once: re-roll the dice that missed, and mark a Condition. When you know enough, or the night is full, end the Investigation and unmask the folk-being.

phaseOpening.title: Make your investigator
phaseOpening.prompt: Name your investigator, pick an archetype, a drive and a dark secret. Spread 12 points over your four attributes (2 to 4 each), then 8 points over your skills (at most 3 in one). Note a keepsake.

phaseOpening.title: Where the trouble lies
phaseOpening.prompt: Roll for the place the letter comes from.

phaseOpening.title: Who wrote to you? Give a name.
phaseOpening.prompt: Name the person who asked for help, in a few words.
phaseOpening.tip: They become an NPC. They want it ended, and hide something about it.

effects.name: {answer}
effects.agenda: Wants the trouble ended, and hides something about it.

phaseOpening.title: What has gone wrong there? A few words.
phaseOpening.prompt: Say in a few words what the letter describes.

phases.name: Investigation
phases.description: Dig, survive, rest. End this phase when you know enough or the night is full.

bands.label: The night still holds.
Night has fallen: the folk-being strikes. Face it now.

phaseClosing.title: Did you learn what it truly wanted?
Did you face it at the risk of harm?
Did your drive or your dark secret come into play?
What do you carry home?
phaseClosing.prompt: Say what this mystery left you with. Your wounds and strain heal before the next letter.

fields.label: Archetype
fields.hint: Who you were before you saw the hidden folk: a priest, a doctor, a soldier, a scholar, a servant…

fields.label: Drive
fields.hint: Why you keep walking toward the dark.

fields.label: Dark secret
fields.hint: What you hide, even from the society.

fields.label: Vigour
fields.hint: Strength, stamina and grit.

fields.label: Finesse
fields.hint: Speed, balance and a steady hand.

fields.label: Reason
fields.hint: Learning, logic and a sharp eye.

fields.label: Heart
fields.hint: Warmth, will and understanding of people.

fields.label: Bodily harm
fields.hint: Each one marked costs a die on Vigour and Finesse rolls. All three: you are broken until someone tends you.

fields.label: Strain on the mind
fields.hint: Each one marked costs a die on Reason and Heart rolls and on Stand Fast. All three: you are broken until you rest.

fields.label: Brawl
fields.hint: Vigour. Fists, knives, cudgels.

fields.label: Endure
fields.hint: Vigour. Cold, hunger, poison, long nights.

fields.label: Haul
fields.hint: Vigour. Lift, break, climb by main force.

fields.label: Shoot
fields.hint: Finesse. Pistols, rifles, bows, throwing.

fields.label: Sneak
fields.hint: Finesse. Move unseen, hide, pick a lock.

fields.label: Nimble
fields.hint: Finesse. Run, leap, dodge, keep your footing.

fields.label: Lore
fields.hint: Reason. Old stories, rites and the ways of the hidden folk.

fields.label: Inquiry
fields.hint: Reason. Search a room, an archive or a body.

fields.label: Alertness
fields.hint: Reason. Notice danger before it notices you.

fields.label: Persuade
fields.hint: Heart. Convince, charm, bargain, deceive.

fields.label: Mend
fields.hint: Heart. Treat wounds and sickness, calm the shaken.

fields.label: Insight
fields.hint: Heart. Read moods, motives and lies.

fields.label: Experience
fields.hint: Spend 5 to raise a skill by one between mysteries.

fields.label: Keepsakes and gear
fields.hint: A lantern, a keepsake from home, and what you carry.
